title: External MCP connections
intro: Connect a public HTTPS MCP server for your account, review its tools, and choose which socios may request them. Other people do not inherit your connection. Disconnecting here clears $t(common:product)’s credentials and access; revoke the provider’s own grant there if needed.
approval: Tools are available in your web chats. External calls need your approval every time and cannot be undone here. Interrupted calls are not automatically repeated.

authorize.label: Authorization review
authorize.intro: You will authorize this external provider. Review its identity and select the scopes you want to request.
authorize.noScopes: The provider publishes no optional scopes.
authorize.required: The server requested: {{scopes}}. A scope selection does not guarantee provider access.
authorize.clientNote: Optional when this provider requires a client registered for $t(common:product)’s callback. The client must belong to the issuer above.
authorize.clientRequired: This provider requires a pre-registered client.
authorize.invalidUrl: The provider returned an invalid authorization URL.

tools.intro: Review the external tool definitions, then grant specific tools to a socio. The descriptions and permission hints come from the provider. Every call still needs your approval with its complete arguments. Refreshing the catalog clears existing grants so you can review them again.
tools.save: Save tool access for this socio
